discription: A plucked string-like sound using a short noise burst and a resonant comb filter. The comb filter's delay time is tuned to the input frequency to create a resonant pitch.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1,atk=0.001, dec=0.5, combFeedback=0.99;var sig;var env = EnvGen.ar(Env.perc(atk, dec, curve: -4),gate: gate,doneAction: 2);var exciter = WhiteNoise.ar(0.5) * env;sig = CombN.ar(in: exciter,maxdelaytime: 0.1,delaytime: 1.0 / freq,decaytime: combFeedback);sig = sig * amp;Out.ar(out, sig ! 2);}
